description: Server-side rendering utilities and components for Next.js, including render functions, routing, and AMP handling.

classes.name: ServerRouter
classes.description: Implements NextRouter for server-side routing in Next.js, handling route, pathname, query, and navigation methods.

methods.name: renderToHTML
methods.description: Main function to render a Next.js page to HTML, handling data fetching, AMP, and post-processing.

methods.name: renderDocument
methods.description: Renders the complete HTML document including head, body, and AMP handling.

methods.name: checkRedirectValues
methods.description: Validates redirect objects returned from getStaticProps or getServerSideProps.

methods.name: errorToJSON
methods.description: Converts an Error object to JSON format for error reporting.

methods.name: serializeError
methods.description: Serializes an Error object, providing detailed info in dev mode or generic message in production.

methods.name: noRouter
methods.description: Throws an error indicating router is only available on client-side.

methods.name: enhanceComponents
methods.description: Enhances App and Component with optional custom enhancers.
